"""Build and compare independent lab3 variants on Linux ARM; never installs over a course project."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, platform, re, shutil, statistics, subprocess, tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
VARIANTS = {'baseline': 'graphic-baseline.c', 'serial': 'graphic-serial.c', 'parallel': 'graphic.c',
            'fast-scalar':'graphic-fast.c','fast-neon':'graphic-fast.c','fast-parallel':'graphic-fast.c',
            'batch':'graphic-batch.c','batch-parallel':'graphic-batch.c',
            'v4-scalar':'graphic-v4.c','v4-neon':'graphic-v4.c','v4-parallel':'graphic-v4.c',
            'v4-batch':'graphic-v4-batch.c','v4-batch-parallel':'graphic-v4-batch.c',
            'v5-neon':'graphic-v5.c','v5-parallel':'graphic-v5.c',
            'v5-sprint':'graphic-v5-batch.c','v6-sprint':'graphic-v6-batch.c','v7-sprint':'graphic-v7-batch.c','v8-packed':'graphic-v8-batch.c','v8-sprint':'graphic-v8-batch.c','v9-core':'graphic-v9-batch.c','v9-sprint':'graphic-v9-batch.c','v9-dsu':'graphic-v9-batch.c'}

def parse_metrics(output):
    patterns = {'pixel': r'draw pixel:\s*(\d+) ms', 'rect': r'draw rect:\s*(\d+) ms',
                'line': r'draw line:\s*(\d+) ms', 'jpg': r'\*\*jpeg:\s*(\d+)',
                'png': r'\*\*png:\s*(\d+)', 'font': r'\*\*font:\s*(\d+)',
                'text': r'draw text:\s*(\d+) ms', 'total': r'Total time:\s*(\d+) ms'}
    values = {}
    for name, pattern in patterns.items():
        matches = re.findall(pattern, output)
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate timing: ' + name)
        values[name] = int(matches[0])
    if values['total'] != sum(values[k] for k in values if k != 'total'):
        raise ValueError('Total differs from seven stage timings')
    return values

def parse_precise_metrics(output):
    """Parse separately labelled diagnostics; never substitute course timings."""
    names={'pixel','rect','line','jpg','png','font','text'}
    stages=re.findall(r'^DIAGNOSTIC_STAGE_NS (\w+) (\d+)\s*$',output,re.M)
    totals=re.findall(r'^DIAGNOSTIC_TOTAL_NS (\d+)\s*$',output,re.M)
    marker='DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY=1 includes_flush=0 includes_decode=0 includes_sleep=0'
    if len(stages)!=7 or {k for k,_ in stages}!=names or len(totals)!=1 or output.splitlines().count(marker)!=1:
        raise ValueError('Missing, duplicate or unexpected high-resolution diagnostic data')
    values={k:int(v) for k,v in stages};values['total']=int(totals[0])
    if values['total']!=sum(values[k] for k in names):
        raise ValueError('Diagnostic total differs from seven stage intervals')
    return values

def snapshot():
    values = {}
    for pattern in ('/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_*',
                    '/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp', '/proc/loadavg'):
        import glob
        for name in glob.glob(pattern):
            try:
                if Path(name).is_file(): values[name] = Path(name).read_text().strip()
            except (OSError, UnicodeError): pass
    return values

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--project', required=True, help='Existing course project, used only for external libraries')
    parser.add_argument('--build-only', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--runs', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--threads', type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument('--threshold', type=int, default=65536)
    parser.add_argument('--variants',default='baseline,v4-neon,v4-parallel',help='Comma-separated variant names')
    parser.add_argument('--lto',action='store_true',help='Apply link-time optimization to every selected variant')
    parser.add_argument('--native-cpu',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--vector-report',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--no-stats',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--precise-timing',action='store_true',help='Also build/run a separate nanosecond diagnostic after course-score runs; never replaces the original score')
    parser.add_argument('--disable',default='',help='Comma-separated: line,rect,text-ranges,prepared,neon,many,row-index,packed,products,four-lane,opaque-cull,text-batch,geometry-batch,analytic-lines,geometry-coalesce')
    parser.add_argument('--governor',choices=('keep','performance'),default='keep')
    parser.add_argument('--bind',choices=('none','fast'),default='none')
    parser.add_argument('--active-wait',action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    names=args.variants.split(',')
    disable_names={'line':'FB_DISABLE_LINE_FAST','rect':'FB_DISABLE_RECT_FAST','text-ranges':'FB_DISABLE_TEXT_RANGES',
                   'prepared':'FB_DISABLE_PREPARED','neon':'FB_DISABLE_NEON','many':'FB_DISABLE_MANY','row-index':'FB_DISABLE_ROW_INDEX','packed':'FB_DISABLE_PACKED','products':'FB_DISABLE_PRODUCTS','four-lane':'FB_DISABLE_FOUR_LANE','opaque-cull':'FB_DISABLE_OPAQUE_CULL','text-batch':'FB_DISABLE_TEXT_BATCH','geometry-batch':'FB_DISABLE_GEOMETRY_BATCH','analytic-lines':'FB_DISABLE_ANALYTIC_LINES','geometry-coalesce':'FB_DISABLE_GEOMETRY_COALESCE'}
    disabled=args.disable.split(',') if args.disable else []
    if any(k not in disable_names for k in disabled):parser.error('Unknown --disable item')
    if not names or len(set(names))!=len(names) or any(v not in VARIANTS for v in names):
        parser.error('Unknown or duplicate variant. Choose: '+','.join(VARIANTS))
    if args.runs < 1 or args.runs > 20 or args.threads < 1 or args.threads > 64 or args.threshold < 1:
        parser.error('Invalid runs, threads or threshold')
    if os.name != 'posix': parser.error('Run on the Linux board; this is not a Windows build')
    if any(v.startswith(('fast','batch','v4','v5','v6','v7','v8','v9')) for v in names) and platform.machine().lower() not in ('aarch64','arm64'):
        parser.error('Fast native validation requires the AArch64 board; host simulation is separate')
    project = Path(args.project).resolve(strict=True)
    external = project / 'common/external'
    if not (external / 'include').is_dir() or not (external / 'lib').is_dir():
        parser.error('Missing course common/external/include or lib')
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for name, expected in manifest['sourceHashes'].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise RuntimeError('Package file changed: ' + name)
    record = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='board-comparison-', dir=str(ROOT)))
    print('Records:', record, flush=True)
    compiler = subprocess.run(['gcc','--version'], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    (record/'compiler.txt').write_text(compiler,encoding='utf-8')
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = str(external/'lib') + os.pathsep + environment.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH','')
    # RuntimeControls records the untouched inherited thread environment first.
    from runtime_controls import RuntimeControls
    controls=RuntimeControls(args,record,environment)
    def flags_for(variant):
        flags=['-O3','-Wall']
        if variant.endswith('parallel') or variant in ('v5-sprint','v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu'):flags+=['-fopenmp','-DFB_PARALLEL_MIN_PIXELS='+str(args.threshold)]
        if variant.endswith('scalar'):flags+=['-DFB_DISABLE_NEON']
        if variant=='v8-packed':flags+=['-DFB_DISABLE_PRODUCTS']
        if variant=='v9-core':flags+=['-DFB_DISABLE_GEOMETRY_BATCH']
        if variant=='v9-dsu':flags+=['-DFB_GEOMETRY_DSU']
        if args.lto:flags+=['-flto']
        if args.native_cpu:flags+=['-mcpu=native']
        if args.vector_report:flags+=['-fopt-info-vec-optimized']
        if variant.startswith(('v5','v6','v7','v8','v9')):
            flags+=['-D'+disable_names[k] for k in disabled]
            if args.no_stats:flags+=['-DFB_DISABLE_STATS']
        return flags
    results = {'recordedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
               'threads':args.threads, 'threshold':args.threshold, 'compiler':compiler,
               'packageManifest':manifest, 'runs':[], 'commands':{},
               'courseTimingExcludesFlush':True, 'flushTimingsRecordedSeparately':True,
               'runtimeControls':str(controls.path),'disabledOptimizations':disabled,'noStats':args.no_stats,
               'preciseTimingEnabled':args.precise_timing}
    if args.precise_timing:
        results.update({'diagnosticRuns':[],'diagnosticCommands':{},'diagnosticSources':{},
                        'diagnosticTimingIsCourseScore':False,'diagnosticRunOrder':'After all unchanged course-score runs'})
    results['exactNativeChecks']={}
    for variant in names:
        graphic=VARIANTS[variant]
        directory = record/variant
        out = directory/'out'
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in ('test.jpg','test.png','font.ttc'):
            (out/name).symlink_to(ROOT/'out'/name)
        flags=flags_for(variant)
        results.setdefault('validationFlags',{})[variant]=flags
        (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
        from native_checks import native_checks,native_batch_checks
        results['exactNativeChecks'][variant]=native_checks(project,directory,environment,graphic,flags)
        if 'batch' in variant or variant in ('v5-sprint','v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu'):
            results['exactNativeChecks'][variant]+=native_batch_checks(project,directory,environment,graphic,flags)
            print('EXPERIMENT: explicit final-frame batch and/or prepared-image API; preparation and rendering are timed.',flush=True)
        graphics_unit = directory/'graphics-build.c'
        graphics_unit.write_text('#define fb_update fb_update_impl\n#include '+json.dumps(str(ROOT/'common'/graphic))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        main_source=ROOT/'test'/('sprint-v9-main.c' if variant.startswith('v9') else 'sprint-v6-main.c' if variant in ('v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint') else 'sprint-main.c' if variant=='v5-sprint' else 'batch-main.c' if 'batch' in variant else 'main.c')
        command = ['gcc',*flags,'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(external/'include'),
                   str(graphics_unit),
                   str(ROOT/'common'/('image-fast.c' if variant.startswith(('fast','batch','v4','v5','v6','v7','v8','v9')) else 'image.c')), str(ROOT/'common/task.c'),
                   str(main_source), str(ROOT/'flush_probe.c'),
                   '-L'+str(external/'lib'), '-ljpeg','-lfreetype','-lpng','-lasound','-lz','-lm',
                   '-o',str(out/'test')]
        results['commands'][variant] = command
        compiled = subprocess.run(command, env=environment, capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
        (directory/'build.log').write_text(compiled.stdout+compiled.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
        if compiled.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Build failed: '+str(directory/'build.log'))
        if args.precise_timing:
            from prepare_precise_timing import generate
            diagnostic_source=directory/'diagnostic-main.c'
            results['diagnosticSources'][variant]=generate(main_source,diagnostic_source)
            diagnostic_command=[str(diagnostic_source) if arg==str(main_source) else str(out/'test-diagnostic') if arg==str(out/'test') else arg for arg in command]
            results['diagnosticCommands'][variant]=diagnostic_command
            diagnostic_compiled=subprocess.run(diagnostic_command,env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
            (directory/'diagnostic-build.log').write_text(diagnostic_compiled.stdout+diagnostic_compiled.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
            if diagnostic_compiled.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError('Diagnostic build failed: '+str(directory/'diagnostic-build.log'))
        if args.vector_report:
            objdump=shutil.which('objdump')
            if objdump:
                disassembly=subprocess.run([objdump,'-d',str(out/'test')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
                (directory/'disassembly.txt').write_text(disassembly.stdout+disassembly.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
                results.setdefault('disassemblyStatus',{})[variant]=disassembly.returncode
            else:results.setdefault('disassemblyStatus',{})[variant]='objdump unavailable'
        if not args.build_only:
            subprocess.run(['python3',str(ROOT/'preflight.py'),'--project',str(directory),'--lab','test'],check=True)
    if not args.build_only:
        for iteration in range(args.runs):
            # Rotate order to reduce always giving one variant the cold run.
            for variant in names[iteration%len(names):] + names[:iteration%len(names)]:
                out = record/variant/'out'
                before = snapshot()
                run = subprocess.run([str(out/'test')],cwd=out,env=environment,
                                     capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
                logfile = record/variant/('run-%02d.log'%(iteration+1))
                logfile.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
                if run.returncode: raise RuntimeError('Test failed: '+str(logfile))
                metrics = parse_metrics(run.stdout)
                flush = [float(v) for v in re.findall(r'FLUSH_US=(\d+)',run.stderr)]
                if not flush: raise RuntimeError('Missing flush timing: '+str(logfile))
                results['runs'].append({'variant':variant,'iteration':iteration+1,'timingsMs':metrics,
                    'explicitBatchApiExperiment':'batch' in variant or variant in ('v5-sprint','v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu'),
                    'preparedImageApiExperiment':variant in ('v5-sprint','v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu'),'countersDisabled':args.no_stats and variant.startswith(('v5','v6','v7','v8','v9')),
                    'packedArithmeticRequested':variant.startswith(('v8','v9')) and 'packed' not in disabled,
                    'sourceProductsRequested':variant in ('v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu') and 'products' not in disabled,
                    'v9FourLaneRequested':variant.startswith('v9') and 'four-lane' not in disabled,
                    'v9OpaqueCullRequested':variant.startswith('v9') and 'opaque-cull' not in disabled,
                    'v9TextBatchRequested':variant.startswith('v9') and 'text-batch' not in disabled,
                    'v9GeometryBatchRequested':variant in ('v9-sprint','v9-dsu') and 'geometry-batch' not in disabled,
                    'v9GeometryDSURequested':variant=='v9-dsu',
                    'v9GeometryCoalesceRequested':variant in ('v9-sprint','v9-dsu') and 'geometry-batch' not in disabled and 'geometry-coalesce' not in disabled,
                    'batchWorkload':{k:int(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'(submitted_pixels|copied_pixels|row_checks|interval_comparisons|flushes)=(\d+)',run.stdout)},
                    'flushUs':flush,'before':before,'after':snapshot(),'log':str(logfile)})
                print(variant,metrics,flush=True)
                (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
        results['medianMs'] = {v:{k:statistics.median(r['timingsMs'][k] for r in results['runs'] if r['variant']==v)
                                  for k in results['runs'][0]['timingsMs']} for v in names}
        results['targetAssessment']={v:{'medianTotalMs':results['medianMs'][v]['total'],
            'meets40msCourseTiming':results['medianMs'][v]['total']<=40,
            'meets20msCourseTiming':results['medianMs'][v]['total']<=20,
            'explicitBatchApiExperiment':'batch' in v or v in ('v5-sprint','v6-sprint','v7-sprint','v8-packed','v8-sprint','v9-core','v9-sprint','v9-dsu'),'courseTimingExcludesFlush':True} for v in names}
        print(json.dumps(results['medianMs'],indent=2))
        # Preserve the completed original scores even if an optional diagnostic
        # later fails validation or execution.
        (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
        if args.precise_timing:
            # Execute only after the original-score sequence has completed so
            # added diagnostic runs cannot warm its caches or heat its CPUs.
            print('DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: separate CLOCK_MONOTONIC intervals; original course scores above remain authoritative.',flush=True)
            for iteration in range(args.runs):
                for variant in names[iteration%len(names):]+names[:iteration%len(names)]:
                    out=record/variant/'out';before=snapshot()
                    run=subprocess.run([str(out/'test-diagnostic')],cwd=out,env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
                    logfile=record/variant/('diagnostic-run-%02d.log'%(iteration+1));logfile.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
                    if run.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Diagnostic failed: '+str(logfile))
                    values=parse_precise_metrics(run.stdout)
                    flush=[float(v) for v in re.findall(r'FLUSH_US=(\d+)',run.stderr)]
                    if not flush:raise RuntimeError('Missing diagnostic flush timing: '+str(logfile))
                    results['diagnosticRuns'].append({'variant':variant,'iteration':iteration+1,'timingsNs':values,
                        'isCourseScore':False,'timingInstrumentationChanged':True,'flushUs':flush,
                        'before':before,'after':snapshot(),'log':str(logfile)})
                    print('diagnostic',variant,{k:v/1000000.0 for k,v in values.items()},flush=True)
                    (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
            results['diagnosticMedianMs']={v:{k:statistics.median(r['timingsNs'][k] for r in results['diagnosticRuns'] if r['variant']==v)/1000000.0
                for k in ('pixel','rect','line','jpg','png','font','text','total')} for v in names}
    (record/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    controls.restore()
    print('Done:', record)

if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Board-only memory-buffer checks; uses real ARM intrinsics and real FreeType."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def native_checks(project,record,environment,graphic='graphic-fast.c',extra_flags=None):
    check=record/('native-checks-'+Path(graphic).stem);check.mkdir()
    source=(ROOT/'common'/graphic).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    globals_=source[source.index('static int LCD_FB_FD;'):source.index('void fb_init(')]
    globals_=globals_.replace('static int LCD_FB_FD;\n','').replace('static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];',
      'static struct {int before[GUARD_WORDS];int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];int after[GUARD_WORDS];} TEST_BACK;\n#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels')
    (check/'graphics-under-test.c').write_text('#include "common.h"\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n'+globals_+source[source.index('static void _copy_area('):])
    common=['gcc',*(extra_flags if extra_flags is not None else ['-O3','-Wall','-fopenmp','-DFB_PARALLEL_MIN_PIXELS=1']),'-Wextra','-I'+str(check),'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),
            '-I'+str(ROOT/'tests'),'-I'+str(project/'common/external/include')]
    passed=[]
    tests=['test_fast_rows','test_lab2_regression','test_images','test_text_real']
    if graphic in ('graphic-baseline.c','graphic-serial.c','graphic.c'):tests=['test_lab2_regression','test_images']
    if 'v8' in graphic or 'v9' in graphic:
        tests=[n if n!='test_fast_rows' else 'test_v8_rows' for n in tests]+['test_v8_arithmetic','test_v8_product_storage']
    if 'v9' in graphic:tests=[n if n!='test_v8_rows' else 'test_v9_rows' for n in tests]
    if 'v4' in graphic or 'v5' in graphic or 'v6' in graphic or 'v7' in graphic or 'v8' in graphic or 'v9' in graphic:tests+=['test_line_exact']
    if 'v5' in graphic or 'v6' in graphic or 'v7' in graphic or 'v8' in graphic or 'v9' in graphic:tests+=['test_prepared']
    if 'v9' in graphic:tests+=['test_v9_pixels','test_v9_cull','test_v9_alloc','test_v9_geometry','test_v9_text_real']
    for name in tests:
        exe=check/name
        sources=[str(ROOT/'tests'/(name+'.c'))]
        if name not in ('test_fast_rows','test_v8_rows','test_v9_rows'):sources += [str(ROOT/'common/image-fast.c')]
        if name=='test_line_exact':sources+=['-DFB_USE_REAL_IMAGE']
        if name=='test_v9_cull':sources+=['-DFB_CULL_TEST_STATS']
        command=common+sources+['-L'+str(project/'common/external/lib'),'-ljpeg','-lpng','-lfreetype','-lz','-lm','-o',str(exe)]
        built=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=180)
        (check/(name+'-build.log')).write_text(built.stdout+built.stderr)
        if built.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native validation build failed: '+str(check/(name+'-build.log')))
        args=[str(exe)]+([str(ROOT/'out/font.ttc')] if name in ('test_text_real','test_v9_text_real') else [])
        for threads in ((1,2,4) if name in ('test_images','test_text_real','test_prepared','test_v9_pixels','test_v9_cull','test_v9_alloc','test_v9_geometry','test_v9_text_real') else (1,)):
            env=dict(environment);env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']=str(threads);env['OMP_THREAD_LIMIT']=str(threads)
            run=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT/'out',capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=180)
            log=check/(name+'-'+str(threads)+'.log');log.write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
            print(run.stdout,flush=True)
            if run.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native pixel validation failed: '+str(log))
            passed.append(name+'-'+str(threads))
    return passed

def native_batch_checks(project,record,environment,graphic='graphic-batch.c',extra_flags=None):
    check=record/('native-batch-checks-'+Path(graphic).stem);check.mkdir()
    source=(ROOT/'common'/graphic).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    globals_=source[source.index('static int LCD_FB_FD;'):source.index('void fb_init(')]
    globals_=globals_.replace('static int LCD_FB_FD;\n','').replace('static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];',
      'static struct {int before[GUARD_WORDS];int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];int after[GUARD_WORDS];} TEST_BACK;\n#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels')
    (check/'graphics-under-test.c').write_text('#include "common.h"\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n'+globals_+source[source.index('static void _copy_area('):])
    passed=[]
    for capacity in (256,3):
        exe=check/('check-'+str(capacity))
        command=['gcc',*(extra_flags if extra_flags is not None else ['-O3','-Wall','-fopenmp']),'-Wextra','-DFB_BATCH_CAPACITY='+str(capacity),
                 '-I'+str(check),'-I'+str(ROOT/'common'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'tests'),'-I'+str(project/'common/external/include'),
                 str(ROOT/'tests/test_opaque_batch.c'),str(ROOT/'common/image-fast.c'),
                 '-L'+str(project/'common/external/lib'),'-ljpeg','-lpng','-lfreetype','-lz','-lm','-o',str(exe)]
        build=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=environment,timeout=180)
